ios.desc:
Grubhub is changing the food delivery game. Hundreds of thousands of restaurants, groceries, and exclusive deals for our regulars—one of which could be you. But the real play: No delivery or service fees on restaurant orders over $50. Seriously. Just more of the food you love without the fees that turn bigger orders into bigger costs.  

SAY GOODBYE TO DELIVERY AND SERVICE FEES ON $50+ RESTAURANT ORDERS
You read that right. No delivery fees. No service fees. No more fees on restaurant orders over $50. Whether you’re ordering for your family, hosting friends, or placing a group order, Grubhub makes it easier to order more without worrying about fees at checkout. Learn more at bit.ly/GHEatTheFees 

ORDER FROM HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS OF RESTAURANTS 
We have what you want, from local restaurants to the chains we all know and love. Think: Taco Bell, McDonald’s, KFC, Pizza Hut, Popeyes, Papa John's, Burger King, Dunkin’, Starbucks, Buffalo Wild Wings, Chipotle, Wendy’s, Jersey Mikes, Jimmy Johns, Panda Express, Arby’s, Panera Bread, Shake Shack, and more.

French fries, pizza, burritos, burgers, sushi, donuts—okay we’re making ourselves hungry, now. What we’re saying is that we have it all. And if you ever need guidance for your next meal, check out our restaurant ratings and reviews. Then, just pay your way (minus the delivery and service fees on $50+ restaurant orders) with credit cards, PayPal, Venmo, Amazon Pay, cash app, and gift cards.


GET IN ON THE EXCLUSIVE OFFERS 
The key is Grubhub+. Sign up for unlimited $0 delivery fees and lower service fees on eligible orders—on top of no delivery or service fees on $50+ restaurant orders—and enjoy exclusive offers and rewards as a Grubhub+ member.* Try Grubhub+ free for 30 days, then level up for just $9.99/month. We promise: Food tastes better when you spend less on delivery. 

TRACK DELIVERY IN REAL TIME 
Grubhub puts your delivery on the map. Track eligible orders in real time, from the restaurant to your front door, and know the moment your meal arrives. Every delivery is a special delivery with Grubhub.

COUNT ON THE GRUBHUB GUARANTEE 
We want you to get the best available prices compared to prices available though an eligible Grubhub competitor, or we’ll make it right. Enter: the Grubhub Guarantee. If a lower price is found on another platform for an eligible order, we’ll issue you the difference in Grubhub credits and provide a $5 credit toward your next order. See details at grubhub.com/guarantee

GET SUPP
